name: Teal and orange

influenced_by: the rise of digital color grading (DaVinci Resolve and similar tools) in the 2000s

garments: not a fashion look — a film color-grading convention

media.title: O Brother, Where Art Thou? (2000)
media.note: widely cited as the first major film to use an all-digital color-timing pass, helping popularize the technique

reacts_against: flatter, less graded film stock color, pushing skin tones (orange) and backgrounds/shadows (teal) toward opposite ends of the color wheel for more pop on a theater or TV screen — a technique later widely criticized by critics and editors as an overused default.
